_about: Sites that existed when tools/production/architecture_rules_audit.dart was added (2026-11-11). Counts per key; only a count above these fails. --sync-baseline lowers counts and drops fixed entries; it never adds. Add an entry by hand only with a reason.

file_paths.dart::_ImagingServiceFilePath.reason: Downcast to reach the host's file listing for keeper numbering; belongs on a HostFiles role member. Existing when the gate was added.

_node_editor.dart::_NodeEditor._buildTyp.reason: One inspector editor widget per node type; an exhaustive sealed switch so a new type does not compile until it has an editor (k-nodedesc kept it on purpose).

calibration_run.rs::is_calibration_only.reason: Domain predicate, Rust twin of eon_plan.dart isCalibrationOnlySequence.

eon_plan.dart::isCalibrationOnlySequence.reason: Domain predicate (steps a calibration-only plan may hold), not type metadata (k-nodedesc).

node_durations.dart::_SequenceTimeEstima.reason: Time estimator rules read the overhead config and the site (k-nodedesc).

node_summary.dart::nodeSummary.reason: The row summary of each node type; exhaustive sealed switch, compiler-checked (k-nodedesc).

node_timing_section.dart::NodeTimingSect.reason: Per-type timing detail rows in the inspector. Candidate for NodeKind or the exhaustive switch form.

node_timing_section.dart::hasMeaningfulD.reason: Exhaustive sealed switch kept with the timing section (k-nodedesc). Candidate NodeKind field.

preflight.rs::collect_required_devices.reason: Rust preflight's per-type device requirements; the Dart side reads NodeKind.requiredDevices. Candidate for a NodeType method next to wire_name.

sequence_serializer.dart::SequenceSerial.reason: Translation into the Rust executor's own vocabulary (snake_case keys, settings-resolved values); pinned by the executor-wire goldens (k-nodedesc).

sequence_serializer.dart::shutdownWarmUp.reason: Domain predicate (steps that put the rig away), not type metadata (k-nodedesc).

sequence_state.dart::Sequence._nodeOverh.reason: Per-type overhead seconds read from the overhead config. Candidate NodeKind field.

sequence_timeline.dart::SequenceTimeline.reason: Timeline segment kind per node type. Candidate NodeKind field.

srcImport.note: Existing imports of another package's src/ files. Fix by importing the public library (export the name there if needed), then run --sync-baseline.
